subject: Publish current solver and benchmark core
body:
Consolidate the unpublished research history for GitHub publication, omitting historical large artifacts. The published tree is byte-identical to research at 53c89957af90ece6d59b5e39605bcb5a06913029. Full original local history is retained on codex/research-before-publish-20261022.

Includes the latest solver, GMB/corpus evaluation, repository and test organization, and removal of historical fixture regressions. Latest validation: 1650 tests passed and Ruff passed.

subject: fix(solver): harden geometry and freeze research baseline a1
body:
Correct triangle centers and scale-sensitive geometry, preserve candidate
identity and verification state, and enforce deadline-safe artifact receipts.
Share problem analysis, scalar evaluations, verification samples and exact
results without changing successful-search stopping or completeness policy.

Retain regression coverage, remove unused helpers and stale documentation,
and document the solver-a1 freeze and its validation limits.

Validation: 1040 tests passed; 323-case static validation; Ruff; schema;
compileall; fresh-process imports; engine/dependency identity checks;
locked-dependency isolated-wheel CLI, worker and exact-answer smoke tests.
No additional full-corpus solve campaign or Windows/macOS execution.

subject: fix(solver): harden numerical evaluation and reduce repeated HP work
body:
Use numeric geometry kernels and exact-point evaluation snapshots; share constant constructions and logical residual plans. Preserve branch/domain checks and improved refinement coordinates on deadlines.

Reduce HP type-check overhead without caching mutable validation results. Add regression tests and update README and engine lock.

Validated source 3d2dcdf1: 527 tests passed excluding GMB, 323 known-configuration evaluations unchanged, and 310 previously accepted representative configurations reverified. Clean Linux wheel smoke and integrity checks passed. HP type-check microbenchmark improved 28%; this is not a full-solver speedup claim.

subject: refactor: remove obsolete repair assets and unused runtime paths
body:
Keep historical migration and repair evidence in c30f97d9; remove it from the working tree. Retain independent configurations and forbidden-boundary regressions as self-contained test fixtures.

Remove dormant selector freezing, MP namespace replacement, unused helpers and inert options. Preserve existing geometry rejection behavior, the search/refinement pipeline, and all 323 DSL files and reference values. Require explicit stress-run case selection instead of the historical fixed 60-case sample.

Verified: 286 tests, 323-case corpus integrity, Ruff, syntax/schema checks, fresh imports, matching float/HP runtime symbols, and Linux clean-wheel API/worker/exact-answer smoke. This is not a new full-corpus performance run.

subject: fix: finish research geometry cleanup and repair MP numeric dispatch
body:
Remove 12 unused geometry helpers, the nonexistent mpmath_geometry fallback and dead prime lookup data. Point IsInteger.mp and IsPrime.mp at the active MP implementations; preserve the DSL pipeline, search config and 323-case corpus.

Add 13 regressions covering direct/runtime/DSL MP parity, live polygon/acute behavior, retired helpers and missing internal imports. Verify all 309 tests, 16 fresh imports, corpus hashes, schemas, Ruff and an external clean wheel. Update the engine lock and cleanup record; preserve the historical import manifest.

subject: research: replace legacy solver with cleaned pipeline and 323-case corpus
body:
Import the current codex/solver-hardening worktree, including its uncommitted fixes, without changing product or active corpus bytes. Keep regression tests, runners, dependency locks and source-audit ledgers; exclude historical campaigns, UI/HTTP, Julia and one-off repair writers.

Extract boundary candidates and independent configurations into small fixtures. Replace repair regeneration with a read-only audit loader. Verify 296 tests, 323-case validation, all 555 import hashes, 16 fresh imports, schemas, Ruff and Linux wheel smoke. Preserve research history and the original worktree; no freeze tag or push.
